_comment: The canonical control-plane inventory (design 15, ADR-55): one name, one abbreviation, one install path and one version authority per workload - declared ONCE, as data, exactly like the feature registry. Consumed by GET /nexus/inventory, imported by the System view at build time, joined with live source levels by `hg observability inspect`, and cited (never restated) by _docs/wiki/platform/observability.md. `source` names the overlay source kind whose level stands in for this workload; null means no source levels it yet and it must render unknown, never green.

workloads.name: ArgoCD
workloads.role: Reconciles the GitOps repository into the cluster
workloads.installedBy: pulumi stage 3 (infra/src/components/argocd); locally hg up ensureArgoCd
workloads.versionAuthority: infra stack config, plus a third copy in cli/src/lib.ts (gaps §03)

workloads.name: Prometheus
workloads.role: Scrapes and stores every metric the platform reads
workloads.versionAuthority: kube-prometheus-stack pinned in platform code, not environment config (ADR-45 Cost)

workloads.name: Grafana
workloads.versionAuthority: kube-prometheus-stack pinned in platform code, not environment config (ADR-45 Cost)

workloads.name: Alertmanager
workloads.role: Notification routing authority for PrometheusRule alerts
workloads.versionAuthority: kube-prometheus-stack pinned in platform code, not environment config (ADR-45 Cost)

workloads.name: Communication router
workloads.role: Fans events out to agent gateways and ChatOps
workloads.installedBy: bootstrap/applicationsets (communication records); locally hg up ensureEventRouter
workloads.versionAuthority: hermes-event-router chart at the platform revision (router.ts ships in the chart)

workloads.name: Communication queue
workloads.role: Redis Streams durable transport and dead-letter queues
workloads.installedBy: hermes-event-router chart, when a durable provider is declared
workloads.versionAuthority: hermes-event-router chart at the platform revision

workloads.name: Webhook gateway
workloads.role: Signature-verified external webhook ingress on the router
workloads.installedBy: hermes-event-router chart (external inputs in the compiled routing record)
workloads.versionAuthority: hermes-event-router chart at the platform revision

workloads.name: Cloudflare Tunnel
workloads.role: Publishes declared hostnames without opening the cluster
workloads.installedBy: PKO Stack CR per profile (providers.ingress=cloudflare only)
workloads.versionAuthority: infra/pulumi/programs/cloudflare-tunnel at the pinned program revision

workloads.name: ChatOps providers
workloads.role: Provider plugins delivering to chat spaces
workloads.versionAuthority: hermes-event-router chart at the platform revision

workloads.name: Backup services
workloads.role: Labelled CronJobs archiving every declared state volume
workloads.versionAuthority: the owning chart at the platform revision

workloads.name: Nexus
workloads.role: The operational dashboard - a projection, never an authority
workloads.versionAuthority: control-plane/nexus/chart at the platform revision (dist built from nexus-ui)

workloads.name: Hermes runtime
workloads.role: The agent runtime every profile instance runs
workloads.versionAuthority: hermes.source in stack config (the fork); image imported by hg up locally

workloads.name: Reconciliation service
workloads.role: Host systemd timer applying the deployment repository (ADR-54)
workloads.installedBy: hg reconcile install (systemd user timer); pulumi reconciler component
workloads.versionAuthority: reconcile config.json version pin, rewritten by pulumi up
